purpose: One serial eight-hour cold-start A development gate following the completed one-hour hybrid gate; not formal quality inference.

execution_constraints.external_timeout_action: Stop the sole process, preserve every file and report incomplete/failed; no automatic rerun, new ID or increased allowance.
launch_prerequisites: B and any other model/full-fab process have terminated.
Root has reviewed this protocol and frozen the executed source, input, vendor and runtime inventory.
Target run directory does not exist; this is a new declared cold start.

budget_semantics.cp_total: 16 required absolute boundaries 0,1800,...,27000 multiplied by 2 requested seconds =32; event plans request zero CP. No request at terminal t=28800.
budget_semantics.wall: 3600 seconds checked at plan boundaries; preprocessing, construction, serialization and final audit are not preempted. External 4200-second watchdog is a separate hard stop; final acceptance must check both actual end-to-end time and all final bytes.
budget_semantics.constructor: 5-second soft algorithm limit per event; fixed250000 candidate evaluations; preprocessing and nominal checks may exceed soft time. Actual wall remains charged and reported.
budget_semantics.plans: 1200 attempted planner calls, including failures; first reached boundary stops the run.
budget_semantics.logs: 8GiB total-directory admission threshold, checked before the next plan; one last plan/audit/checkpoint may overshoot. Final overshoot is preserved and fails acceptance.
budget_semantics.trace: Runner also stops at a plan boundary if trace.jsonl exceeds256MiB; no CLI override exists and this protocol does not change it.

proportional_sizing_only_not_prediction.assumption: Eight repeated hours at the first-hour event/file/time rate. Ignores longer-run changes in WIP, arrivals, route depths, breakdowns, lateness, candidate density and final checkpoint growth.

cold_start_and_reproduction.initial_state: Original source WIP plus common time-zero releases; seed1701 event-keyed physical random mechanism, full913 production machines; not warmed steady state.
cold_start_and_reproduction.horizon_compatibility: The old3600-second checkpoint cannot be extended via --snapshot-path: runner requires exactly the saved horizon.
cold_start_and_reproduction.new_source_variant: Current shared constructive_tool extraction postdates original one-hour snapshot; exact tiny-fixture event plan/action equivalence is covered by test_smt_fullfab_constructive_tool. Freeze exact new source before launch; do not claim byte-identical old runtime.
cold_start_and_reproduction.determinism_limit: Fixed seed and single worker do not guarantee identical CP or wall-truncated constructive results across hardware/runtime loads.

acceptance: status success, simulation_seconds28800, full_window_completed true and model_calls0.
Independent full-window physical, production-source and decision-opportunity audits valid; full913-machine declared scope; no silent dispatch, disabled constraint or pruned machine family.
Every planner reserve matched to finish and immutable response/explicit failure; CP requested<=32; 16 periodic plans if the full window completed; event constructor costs separately reported.

Actual final run wall<=3600 and outer measured wall<=4200, total preserved directory bytes<=8589934592, trace bytes<=268435456 and attempted plans<=1200. A runner success alone does not waive post-run resource checks.

Preserve complete source/data/runtime provenance, trace, all problems/results, audit, result, checkpoint and cumulative checkpoint_resources; freeze any later recovery separately without resetting consumed counters.
stopping: First resource, model-status, nominal or independent-audit failure is retained. No automatic second run, cap increase, conditional cancellation, reference fallback, model use, or formal matrix.
interpretation: A successful gate establishes only bounded eight-hour execution/feasibility and measured cost for this seed/version. It does not prove a strong baseline, relative quality superiority, steady-state performance or factory simulator equivalence.

implementation_verification.note: Synthetic saved-evidence tests only; the source inventory and runtime must still be frozen before the registered serial launch.
